IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BatteryFailed: Couldn't change the battery: the watch or battery isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoBatteryToRemove: There's no battery in the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_OneWatchOnly: You can only wear one map watch. Take the other one off first.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_TwoWorn: You're wearing two map watches. Only the one on your left wrist works; take the other one off.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ApiMissing: Map Watch is not active: the MiniMap mod is too old, so the minimap stays open. Please update the MiniMap mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareApiMissing: Comm range is not active: the MiniMap mod is too old, so faction sharing has no distance limit. Please update the MiniMap mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Off: The server has disabled the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoWatch: Wear a map watch to use the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoBattery: The map watch has no battery
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Dead: The map watch battery is dead
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_Dead: Battery dead: insert a fresh battery to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_FeatureOff: The server has disabled this feature
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NeedWatch: Wear a map watch to use this
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Need_mildet: The world map requires the Military Detector Module
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleFailed: Couldn't install or remove: the watch or module isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NeedScrewdriver: You need a screwdriver to install or remove modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotFull: This slot already has a module. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotWrongClass: This slot can't take this type of module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UnlockFailed: Can't use the unlock card: this slot isn't opened with unlock cards, or the card isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_AlreadyUnlocked: This slot is already open. The unlock card was not used.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UnlockNoAccount: Can't use the unlock card: this character's account can't be verified (split-screen players 2-4 can't use them).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_compass: When a target is off-screen, shows a direction arrow and the remaining distance at the edge of the minimap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_ledger: Shows resource points like gun stores and pharmacies on the map, with a legend. Searching points by category doesn't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_gps: Road navigation, multi-stop trips, and one-click route home. Your own coordinates don't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_comm: Share targets with your faction and see teammates on the map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_scan: Shows nearby vehicles and animals on the minimap and world map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_detect: Marks nearby zombies on the minimap and shows zombie heat. How often it updates depends on the server's scan settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_mildete: Doubles the detection radius, and shows zombie positions and heat on the world map too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_longcom: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_relay: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_eco: Halves the whole watch's power drain, doubling battery life.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareRange: %1 Sharing range: %2 tiles. Both the sharer and the recipient need a comms module; the larger of their two ranges applies.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareRangeUnlimite: %1 When either the sharer or the recipient has a Relay Core, faction sharing has no distance limit (both still need a comms module).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Core: The Relay Core and Power-Saver Core can only go here.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Addon: This slot was added by another mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Orphan: The mod that added this slot has been removed: the module is paused and draws no power. You can still take it out; when the mod is back, the slot and its unlock come back too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Empty: Drag a module from your inventory here, press a module button below, or right-click a module and choose "Install to Map Watch". Takes about 3 seconds and needs a screwdriver; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Card: This server opens slots with unlock cards. Use one %1 to open the %2 permanently. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_CardOpened: Opened with an unlock card. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Paused: The %1 isn't open, so this module is disabled and uses no power. It's still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Dead: The battery is dead, so this module is paused.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_UNKNOWN_: This slot isn't for sale right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_MODE_NOT: This server doesn't sell this slot through the economy.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_HAVE_PER: You already own this slot, so there's no need to rent it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_RENTING_: Your rental has auto-renew on. Turn it off before buying the slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_READ_FAI: Couldn't read your purchases right now. Please try again later.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Lapsed: The rental for the %1 has ended. Renew it before installing.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoEcon: The server has no economy system, so this slot uses unlock cards for now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoClient: Your Economy mod is too old to pay here. Whether the slot works is still decided by the server.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAccountBound: It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNotSold: This server isn't selling the %1 right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoBuy: This server doesn't sell it outright.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayBuyAutoOn: Auto-renew is on for your rental. Turn it off before buying the slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayBought: You own this slot. It's yours for good.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoOff: Auto-renew is off: the slot stops working the moment the rental ends.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNeedConsent: The rent, currency or period changed, so auto-renew is paused. Press "Accept New Terms" to keep it going.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoPaused: Auto-renew is paused: the server has stopped rentals or can't charge right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayLapsed: The rental has ended: renew it before installing a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayLapsedModule: The rental has ended, so the %1 is disabled. It's still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayFailFunds: Auto-renew couldn't charge you (not enough %1, %2 short).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayRetryWindow: It retries every hour for the next %1 and turns the slot back on once it's paid.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayRenewToRestore: Renew to turn it back on right away.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayFrozen: The mod that added this slot was removed, so the rental is frozen: no rent is charged, %1 is left, and it continues when the mod is back.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoAnswer: The server didn't answer, so the payment result is unknown. Press "Check Purchase" to find out; you won't be charged twice.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayQuoteNoAnswer: The server didn't answer, and nothing was paid. Please try again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayDuplicate: That was already paid; you weren't charged twice.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoOrder: That payment didn't go through. You can buy again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayPaidAutoFailed: Paid, but auto-renew wasn't turned on: %1
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoUnknown: The server didn't answer, so it's unclear whether auto-renew changed. Reopen the panel later to check.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayPriceChanged: The price just changed and the new price is shown above. Check it, then press "Pay" again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PaySheetAuto: When it ends, %1 is taken from your wallet for another %2 days. If that fails it retries every hour for up to %3 hours, and the slot is off meanwhile. You can cancel any time.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BannerRetry: The rental for the %1 has ended and the %2 is disabled; auto-renew keeps retrying for %3.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PlanTermsChanged: The %1's rent, currency or period changed: players with auto-renew must accept again before they're charged.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_DrainHalf: None; halves the whole watch's drain
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyInstall: Installing %1 into %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyRemove: Removing %1 from %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays on the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Full: The %1 already holds the %2. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Class: The %1 is a %2-class module; the %3 only accepts %4 modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Charge: Battery %1%%, about %2 left (real time; about %3 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargeUnderHo: Battery %1%%, under 1 hour left (real time; about %2 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Dead: No power: insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NotWorn: This watch isn't being worn: modules only work while it's on your wrist.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NoBattery: No battery: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_Dead: Battery dead: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoModuleToInstall: No modules in your inventory fit this slot
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_light: A light on your watch: when on, it lights up about %1 tiles around you, and nearby players can see it too. No drain while off.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_LightFailed: Couldn't turn on the light: the Light Module isn't working or the watch has no charge.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UiTooOld: The Map Watch panel needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework (API rev 14 or later). Please update the UI framework.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargingCar: Charging in the car, full in about %2. %1
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargingHouse: Charging in a powered building, full in about %2. %1
